description: Look up several products in one call from a comma-separated list of identifiers (barcodes, ASINs, URLs, model numbers or ShopSavvy IDs) and return the product_lookup fields for each one found. Use it when comparing two or more specific products. Free without an API key; 1 credit per product found with a key. Identifiers that match nothing are left out of the result: report those as not found rather than guessing.

identifiers.description: Comma-separated list of product identifiers (barcodes, ASINs, URLs, etc.)

name: product_lookup_batch
title: Look up several products
